description: Mapa de áreas de riesgo ambiental por inundación fluvial T=500 años is a dataset listed in Official INSPIRE Data and Services Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by miteco.gob.es. Environmental risk map (areas) for a low-probability flood scenario (500-year return period), taking into account information on water bodies, abstractions, recreational areas and habitats. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Map of environmental risk areas from river flooding T=500 years" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2024-11-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-codsi.
